accounts_email_lowercase.name: accounts_email_lowercase
accounts_email_lowercase.value: "accounts"."email" is null or ("accounts"."email" = lower("accounts"."email") and length("accounts"."email") <= 254)

accounts_password_needs_email.name: accounts_password_needs_email
accounts_password_needs_email.value: "accounts"."password_hash" is null or "accounts"."email" is not null

accounts_verified_needs_email.name: accounts_verified_needs_email
accounts_verified_needs_email.value: "accounts"."email_verified_at" is null or "accounts"."email" is not null

quest_progress_claim_complete.name: quest_progress_claim_complete
quest_progress_claim_complete.value: ("quest_progress"."claimed_at" is null) = ("quest_progress"."ledger_id" is null) and ("quest_progress"."claimed_at" is null) = ("quest_progress"."discord_user_id" is null)

quests_active_visit_has_url.name: quests_active_visit_has_url
quests_active_visit_has_url.value: not "quests"."active" or "quests"."kind" <> 'visit' or "quests"."url" is not null
